settings.heading: FAQs
Is Everything on Your Site Spray-Free or Organic?
settings.row_content:
Yes. All fresh produce sold by Joy Wholefoods is spray free, Certified Chemical Free or Certified Organic.

We carefully choose every farmer and supplier and only offer produce that we are happy to feed our own families. We are very particular about how our food is grown and handled.

settings.heading: What Does Spray-Free Mean?
settings.row_content:
Spray free means produce has been grown without synthetic chemical pesticides, herbicides or fungicides.

Many of the spray free farmers we work with grow smaller crops using traditional, regenerative farming methods. These may include homemade compost, crop rotation, companion planting and seed saving.

Natural or organically approved products may occasionally be used to improve soil health or manage excessive pest pressure. These can include seaweed solution, liquid fish, Dipel, organic pyrethrum, copper, sulphur, neem oil and Organic Link.

Spray free produce is grown using methods that work with nature, although it does not carry formal organic certification.

settings.heading: How Do I Know It's Spray-Free?
settings.row_content:
When we take on a new farmer we ask them a series of questions about their farming methods to ensure no nasty chemicals are used at any stage of growing, harvesting or packaging. Some of our farmers are also "in-conversion" to organic or already have organic or chemical-free certification.

Others are only small scale operators so they do seek organic certification due to the time and cost restraints involved.

But the real evidence is in the produce itself! It has no chemical residue, smells like real food should and you will sometimes find a few little critters in there like caterpillars, grasshoppers or even a random tiny frog or spider. Our produce is good enough for everyone to enjoy!

settings.heading: Where Does the Food Come From?
settings.row_content:
We source our produce from approximately 40 small farms. Many are located near our Farmer Kel's place at Sandy Creek (near Woodford) while others are in the Lockyer Valley, Gympie, Bundaberg, Mt Cotton and Gatton, to name a few. We also source a small number of items like carrots and onions from Tasmania and Victoria where the climate is much better for this type of produce.

We prioritise choosing local but we also want to offer plenty of variety for our customers. When items are unavailable here due to the warmer weather, we will sometimes source them from down south through our local Certified Organic wholesaler.

settings.heading: Do You Sell "Ugly", Misshapen Produce?
settings.row_content:
Occasionally we do have produce that doesn't look like your standard produce (how we've come to expect it to look) and we certainly don't discriminate against "ugly" produce if that's what the farmer sends us, we send that out with our regular produce. Sometimes you might find a heart shaped potato (that ain't ugly!) or some oversized zucchinis. But generally our carrots and root vegetables all look quite uniform. This is because the soil our farmers use is such good quality and has been broken down over the years with what occurs naturally in the soil (and not contaminated with pesticides) that there aren't actually a great deal of misshapen vegetables.

If there are any, the farmers usually keep and use them for themselves or sell them to people who own horses. Everyone wins this way. The farmers sell the uniform vegetables because they are paid more for them, they can then afford to feed themselves and they're happy eating the leftover produce or sell them at a discount for the horses so the horses are happy too!

So while we don't have an "ugly produce" section, you can rest assured nothing is going to waste in our small food system.

settings.heading: Produce
Can I create a Subscription order?
settings.row_content:
Yes. Our flexible subscription builder lets you create a recurring order that suits your household.

You can choose one of our seasonal fruit and vegetable boxes for convenience, or build your subscription from our range of everyday staples.

You can add regularly purchased essentials such as milk, bread and eggs. Other products can also be added to your order as one time purchases whenever you need them.

Create your subscription here.

settings.heading: Can I pick exactly what I want?
settings.row_content:
We offer a great range of Seasonal Set Boxes. These boxes are filled to the brim with what’s best and freshest that week from our farmers, and whilst we can accommodate one or two preferences, the contents can’t generally be swapped.

If you prefer to shop your own way and choose exactly what you’ll receive, simply Pick Your Own by choosing from our entire range of Fruits and Veg (we have a lot!) and add any Meat, Bread, Dairy and Grocery items you need too. We’ll pack your box just the way you like it and deliver it to you in a flash.

settings.heading: Do you have a minimum order amount?
settings.row_content:
Yes. The minimum order depends on where you are: $50 for our local delivery areas, $100 for 4510, 4521 and the Southern Gold Coast, and $150 for areas we reach by refrigerated courier, including the Sunshine Coast, Toowoomba, Darling Downs, Granite Belt and northern NSW (a temporary $4 fuel levy also applies). 

Enter your postcode in our delivery checker to see the exact minimum and delivery fee for your area.

settings.heading: When is your order cut-off time?
settings.row_content:
Our order cutoffs are:

• Wednesday delivery: Monday at 10am
• Thursday delivery: Tuesday at 10am
• Friday delivery: Wednesday at 10am

We recommend ordering early because popular products can sell out before the cutoff.

Delivery days vary by postcode, and some areas have more than one option.

Missed the cut-off? Send us a message via website chat or text us on 0480 079 218 and we’ll do our best to help.

settings.heading: Ordering
What do I do at the Pick-up Point?
settings.row_content:
Our pick-up points are our customers homes. They have kindly volunteered to provide space for you to collect your order.

In most places, it's easy to find the boxes. Simply locate the ones with your name on them. Return your empty boxes the following week.

settings.heading: What if I forget to collect my order?
settings.row_content:
We will send you a text message when your order is ready to collect. We ask that you please try to collect within 5 hours to ensure your order is not sitting outside too long. All our pick up points are shady, but they are outdoors, so if you do not collect within this time frame we cannot guarantee your produce will still be perfect.

We ask our pick up point owners to let us know if anyone forgets to collect, but sometimes they are out themselves and we don't know. If we do find out we'll text you another reminder, but essentially it is your responsibility to remember to collect your order. It will be there waiting for you until you collect it.

settings.heading: Can You Make My Home a Pick up Point?
settings.row_content:
This is something we can definitely look at. It would need to fit in with our delivery routes or be in an area we're looking at expanding to. Your house or business would need to have a large, covered, shady area for our boxes to be left for at least half a day, sometimes longer. You wouldn't need to be home the whole time but the area would need to be accessible to our customers during this period without locked gates or dogs.

We also ask that you have space to store any returned boxes that we will come back and collect at another time. If any boxes were left later in the day then we ask that you call us to let us know so we can advise the customer.

If that all sounds great then complete this form and we'll be in touch.

Register Your Interest Here.

settings.heading: Can I get a delivery time for my home delivery?
settings.row_content:
Yes you can! We will SMS you 2 days prior to your delivery with an estimated delivery time. We'll also SMS you again on the day when the driver leaves the warehouse, and when your order is delivered.

Please note the SMS will come from a different number than our regular SMS as we use specialised delivery software for these.

settings.heading: Delivery
What if I'm not happy with the quality of an item I received?
settings.row_content:
We want you to be completely happy with every order.

If an item arrives damaged, spoiled or below the quality you expected, please contact our team directly. We can arrange a replacement with your next order or provide store credit.

Photos are very helpful because they allow us to understand what happened and provide feedback to our farmers and suppliers. However, if you cannot provide a photo, please still contact us. We do not want you to miss out on our 100% Happiness Guarantee.

Please give us the opportunity to make things right. We genuinely value both positive feedback and the chance to resolve any problems.
